fields.assessment_notes: Spellhold has a broader and more reliable Magic calendar than the old Places note implied. Wizards/EventLink shows Saturday Commander plus weekly Modern, Legacy, Standard Showdown, Pioneer, FNM Draft, Premodern, Sunday Pauper, and The Hobbit prerelease dates; the official site supports current operation, MTG inventory depth, and weekly/special event routing. This improves Magic-overall activity and schedule reliability, but the store still reads as a broad/competitive Magic hub more than a proven solo-arrival Commander community. Proxy policy, bracket texture, pod formation, and Discord usefulness remain the main open questions.

operations.reason: Recalibrate Spellhold's Places assessment after correcting incomplete Commander-only event coverage.

positives: Wizards/EventLink shows a broad current weekly Magic schedule across Commander, Modern, Legacy, Standard, Pioneer, Draft, Premodern, and Pauper.
Official site supports active operation, MTG inventory depth, online singles/sealed catalog, and weekly/special-event routing.
Review/directory surfaces point to substantial MTG play space, singles, tournaments, and generally positive staff/community signals.
cautions: Best evidence points to broad/competitive Magic infrastructure, not necessarily a relaxed Commander-first solo-arrival environment.
Pricing/markup complaints appear in some review-derived surfaces, mainly around other TCG events, so event-pricing expectations should be checked.
Discord/public community evidence remains more flyer-board than proven LFG/community-texture support.
open_questions: How welcoming is Saturday Commander for solo arrivals?
What are the actual proxy/bracket expectations for Commander?
Does the Discord contain useful LFG or event-reliability discussion beyond posted flyers?
